messages:
maria: heads up — deploy-bot just blocked RC-42 deploy for EU due to missing audit evidence. compliance wants SBOM signature + vuln delta report before we can release to EU customers. change window ends in 5h. any quick ideas?

deploy-bot: [automated] Release RC-42: gate=security-compliance -> status=BLOCKED
- reason: missing_proof (sbom-signature + vuln-delta)
- artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/rc-42:sha256:abc123
- scanner: vulnscan-v2.1 (exit=0, findings=3, highest=LOW)
- required: signed_sbom_url, vuln_delta_report_url

josh: ack. thanks for the ping. can we get a legit timeboxed hold (<=4h) and continue non-EU canary? if evidence lands earlier we proceed.

anita_sec: quick read — the 3 findings are transitive libs (LOW) but the audit team specifically wants provenance evidence for the base image and a signed SBOM manifest. we can accept a signed SBOM + build environment attestations. if we don't have that we need a documented mitigation.

sam_dev: can we carve out EU region like last week (regional carveout) so customers outside EU aren't impacted? what's the risk surface?

josh: prefer regional carveout for now. Maria, can you coordinate with infra to split the canary and flag EU as hold? deploy-bot should support regional routing.

maria: on it. infra pinged. deploy-bot, please pause EU canary and keep global canary running for non-EU. add a release-note stub that EU delayed pending audit evidence.

deploy-bot: commands executed:
```
pause-canary --region eu-west-1 --release rc-42
continue-canary --exclude-region eu-west-1 --release rc-42
annotate-release --release rc-42 --note "EU: delayed pending audit evidence (SBOM signature + vuln delta)"
```
result: success (actions queued)

legal: FYI — the regulator audit group requested that the release notes include the SBOM signer identity and timestamp. if we can't supply, they want a timeboxed remediation plan included in the public release notes for EU customers.

anita_sec: if we get the signed SBOM + delta report within 2 hours we can allow EU canary to proceed under observation. otherwise we should prepare a pin-and-hotpatch plan: pin the transitive dep to patched hash and schedule hotpatch in changewindow + communicate to audit.

oncall: if evidence doesn't arrive before change window close, what is rollback criteria? do we do a full rollback or leave non-EU live and postpone EU? need SRE input on rollback risk.

josh: decision: leave non-EU canary running. do NOT roll back globally. for EU, hold and prepare rollback branch if evidence missing by change window end. also prep release-notes language and escalation path.

maria: uploaded provisional artifacts to s3: s3://redwood-audit/rc-42/sbom-signed.json.asc and s3://redwood-audit/rc-42/vuln-delta.pdf (private link shared with audit). pinging audit and legal now. link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-audit/rc-42/sbom-signed.json.asc (shared via presigned URL)

anita_sec: confirming signature looks valid at a glance. running the quick provenance check now. if it verifies I'll clear EU canary to run under 30-min observation.

[~20 minutes later]

anita_sec: provenance verified, vuln delta ok (no new HIGH/CRITICAL). clearing EU canary for staged rollout. recommendation: monitor latency/error metrics for first 1000 requests.

deploy-bot: action: resume-canary --region eu-west-1 --release rc-42 --staged=1000

josh: update release notes before final push. maria, please add: "EU rollout resumed after audit evidence provided (SBOM signed by build-ops@redwood.com at 2025-03-21T09:18Z). Transitive vulns are LOW; mitigation plan in place."

maria: added to release notes and changelog: "EU: delayed briefly for audit evidence; signed SBOM attached; no HIGH/CRITICAL findings. See internal audit link for details." link: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/rc-42#audit-evidence

legal: copied the release-note language into the compliance packet. audit ack received: next steps documented.

oncall: monitoring for errors and latency spikes. will escalate if >0.5% error or latency >1.5x baseline.

josh: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for post-mortem notes. please add any follow-ups (e.g., automated SBOM publish to s3 on build success) so we don't hit this manual step again. :thumbsup:

maria: follow-ups logged in the release retro board. closing thread once canary finishes. :white_check_mark:
